comparison.objective: Tighten fifteen pool balls on the foot spot and lift the rack away without disturbing them; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Collective packing of free-rolling objects and drift-free frame removal versus precision impact tooling and tiny metal-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: All 30 neighboring pairs within 0.5 mm, head ball within 5 mm, rack clear, balls still; no fracture/damage threshold is involved.
comparison.reason: The defining ability is tightening and releasing a packed group without disturbance, unrelated to notch fracture and debris recovery.
